part1_desc: 第 1–24 步：学三段式写作，帮小听众改《我的发明》作文。
part2_desc: 第 25–36 步：独立改作文、独立写三句话，预告发明大直播。
note: 本课阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：被动语态书面表达（My invention 三段式写作）。Unit 4 Inventions 主题。

steps.title: 发明故事专栏
steps.teach_html:
【承上启下】昨天在故事里找被动句。今天学用被动语态介绍一个发明。

发明展结束了，广播站要开一个新专栏：《我的发明》，把小听众自己的发明故事播出来。

站长请你写一篇范文，给大家打个样。今天不学新语法，只学怎么写。

steps.title: 三段式结构
steps.teach_html:
“My invention”用三段式来写，一段只讲一件事：

  • 开头：它是什么 + 谁发明的
  • 中间：它怎么做出来的 / 怎么用
  • 结尾：我为什么喜欢它

每段 1–2 句，全篇 4–5 句就够了。

steps.title: 范文
steps.teach_html:
站长和你一起写的范文，5 句话：

My invention is a small robot. It was invented by me last year. It is made of old boxes. It is used to clean my room. I like it because it saves time.

中文意思：我的发明是一个小机器人。它是去年由我发明的。它由旧盒子做成。它用来打扫我的房间。我喜欢它，因为它省时间。

数一数：开头 2 句，中间 2 句，结尾 1 句。

steps.title: 开头怎么写
steps.teach_html:
开头：先说它是什么，再说谁发明的（用过去被动）：

  • My invention is a small robot.（我的发明是一个小机器人。）
  • It was invented by me last year.（它去年由我发明。invent，发明，动词）
  • It was made in my home.（它在我家做出来的。）

公式：It was + 过去分词 + by（由……） + 人。

steps.title: 中间怎么写
steps.teach_html:
中间：说它怎么做、怎么用（用现在被动）：

  • It is made of old boxes.（它由旧盒子做成。make，制造）
  • It is used to clean my room.（它用来打扫房间。use，使用）
  • They are used every day.（它们每天都被用。）

记住两个搭配：be made of（由……制成），be used to（被用来做……）。

steps.title: 结尾怎么写
steps.teach_html:
结尾：说我为什么喜欢它：

  • I like it because（因为） it saves time.（我喜欢它，因为它省时间。）
  • It is useful.（它很有用。）

because 后面跟原因，一句话就够了。

steps.title: 主动改被动
steps.teach_html:
写作小技巧：主动改被动，句子更像范文：

  • My father invented it. → It was invented by my father.
  • Factories make light bulbs（电灯泡）. → Light bulbs are made in factories.

三步走：宾语提前 → be 动词 + 过去分词 → 原来的主语放 by 后面。

steps.title: 检查清单
steps.teach_html:
写完用这个清单检查：

  • 三段都有了吗？（开头 / 中间 / 结尾）
  • 过去的事用了 was / were 吗？现在的事用了 is / are 吗？
  • 每句话都有动词吗？
  • 单词都拼对了吗？

缺一段，就补一段；错一处，就改一处。

steps.title: 小结
steps.teach_html:
小结：

  • 三段式：开头（是什么 + 谁发明）→ 中间（怎么做 + 怎么用）→ 结尾（为什么喜欢）。
  • 开头多用 was invented by，中间多用 is made of / is used to，结尾用 because。

下面帮小听众改作文，练写作！

steps.title: 新任务：改作文
steps.reading: My invention is a water cleaner. It invented by my brother last year. It is make of plastic bottles. It is used to clean water. I like it because it help many people.
steps.teach_html:
新任务：小听众豆豆写了篇《我的发明》，有 3 处小毛病，资料在上面。

你来当小老师：找出毛病，改成范文的样子。站长陪你一起改。

steps.title: 哪句做开头
steps.scene: 豆豆问：开头第一句写什么？
steps.reading: My invention is a water cleaner. It invented by my brother last year. It is make of plastic bottles. It is used to clean water. I like it because it help many people.
steps.stem: 哪句适合做《我的发明》的开头？
options: I like it because it is fun.
It is made of plastic bottles.
My invention is a water cleaner. It was invented by my brother.
It is used to clean water.
steps.help: 不对。开头要先介绍它是什么、谁发明的。
steps.explain: 开头：是什么 + 谁发明的。

wrong_feedback.A: 这是结尾的句子，开头要先介绍它是什么。
wrong_feedback.B: 这是中间段的内容，开头先说它是什么、谁发明的。
wrong_feedback.D: 这是中间段的用法介绍，不是开头。

steps.title: 改第一处
steps.scene: 第一处毛病：It invented by my brother.
steps.reading: My invention is a water cleaner. It invented by my brother last year. It is make of plastic bottles. It is used to clean water. I like it because it help many people.
steps.stem: 豆豆写了 “It invented by my brother.”，怎么改？
options: It was invented by my brother.
It is invented by my brother.
It invents by my brother.
Invented it by my brother.
steps.help: 不对。去年发明的，过去的事。
steps.explain: last year 是过去，用 was invented。

wrong_feedback.B: last year 是过去，不能用 is。
wrong_feedback.C: invents 是主动，意思反了，还缺被动结构。
wrong_feedback.D: 句子缺主语，语序也乱了。

steps.title: 改第二处
steps.scene: 第二处毛病：It is make of plastic bottles.
steps.reading: My invention is a water cleaner. It invented by my brother last year. It is make of plastic bottles. It is used to clean water. I like it because it help many people.
steps.stem: “It is make of plastic bottles.” 怎么改？
options: It is making of plastic bottles.
It makes of plastic bottles.
It made of plastic bottles.
It is made of plastic bottles.
steps.help: 不对。be made of 是固定搭配。
steps.explain: be made of（由……制成）是固定搭配。

wrong_feedback.A: making 是进行时，be made of 才是固定搭配。
wrong_feedback.B: makes of 不是固定搭配，要用 be made of。

steps.title: 改第三处
steps.scene: 第三处毛病：it help many people.
steps.stem: “I like it because it help many people.” 怎么改？
options: I like it because it help many people.
I like it because it helps many people.
I like it because it helping many people.
I like it because it helped many people.
steps.help: 不对。it 是第三人称单数。
steps.explain: it 后面动词加 s：helps。

wrong_feedback.A: it 后面动词要加 s，help 要变成 helps。
wrong_feedback.C: helping 是进行时，这里用 helps。
wrong_feedback.D: helped 是过去，现在喜欢、现在有用，用 helps。

steps.title: 主动改被动
steps.scene: 写作技巧练习：主动改被动。
steps.stem: 主动改被动：“My brother invented it last year.” 选出正确的被动句。
options: It was invented by my brother last year.
It is invented by my brother last year.
It invented by my brother last year.
It was invent by my brother last year.
steps.help: 不对。宾语提前，be + 过去分词。
steps.explain: It was invented by my brother last year.

wrong_feedback.B: last year 是过去，用 was 不用 is。
wrong_feedback.C: 少了 was，invented 前面要有 be 动词。
wrong_feedback.D: invent 是原形，被动要用过去分词 invented。

steps.title: 哪句放中间
steps.reading: My invention is a water cleaner. It invented by my brother last year. It is make of plastic bottles. It is used to clean water. I like it because it help many people.
steps.stem: 哪句适合放在中间段？
options: I like it because it is useful.
My invention is a water cleaner.
It was invented by my brother.
It is used to clean dirty water.
steps.help: 不对。中间段讲怎么做、怎么用。
steps.explain: 中间段：怎么做 / 怎么用。

wrong_feedback.C: 这是开头的发明者介绍。

steps.title: 补全中间段
steps.stem: 补全中间段：“It ___ made of plastic bottles.”
options: are
was
is
were
steps.explain: It is made of ... 单数现在用 is。

wrong_feedback.A: It 是单数，不能用 are。
wrong_feedback.B: 这是说现在的材料，用 is 不用 was。

steps.title: 哪句不能放
steps.scene: 站长考眼力：哪句是多余的？
steps.stem: 哪句不能放进《我的发明》？
options: It is used to clean water.
I had noodles for lunch.
It was invented by my brother.
I like it because it helps people.
steps.help: 不对。哪句跟发明没关系？
steps.explain: 吃午饭跟发明无关，不能放。

wrong_feedback.C: 这是讲发明者的，可以放。

steps.title: 选正确句子
steps.scene: 最后一练：选完全正确的一句。
steps.stem: 选出完全正确的一句。
options: It was invent by my brother.
It is made from plastic bottles yesterday.
It are used to clean water.
It was invented by my brother last year.
steps.help: 不对。一句一句检查时态和主语。
steps.explain: It was invented by my brother last year. 全对。

wrong_feedback.B: yesterday 是过去，不能用 is。
wrong_feedback.C: It 是单数，不能用 are。

steps.title: 写开头
steps.stem: 填空：My invention ___ a flying bike.（我的发明是一辆会飞的自行车。）
steps.explain: My invention is a flying bike.

steps.title: 写发明者
steps.stem: 填空：It ___ invented by me last year.
steps.explain: It was invented by me last year.

common_errors.say: last year 是过去，用 was。

steps.title: 写材料
steps.stem: 填空：It is ___ of old paper.（它由旧纸做成。）
steps.help: 不对。be made of 固定搭配。
steps.explain: It is made of old paper.

common_errors.say: be made of 是固定搭配，用 made。

steps.title: 写原因
steps.stem: 填空：I like it ___ it saves time.（我喜欢它，因为它省时间。）
steps.explain: I like it because it saves time.

common_errors.say: 这里表示原因，用 because（因为）。

steps.title: 主动改被动
steps.stem: 主动改被动填空：Edison invented the light bulb. → The light bulb ___ invented by Edison.
steps.help: 不对。过去的人物，过去的事。
steps.explain: The light bulb was invented by Edison.

common_errors.say: 爱迪生是过去的人物发明，用 was。

steps.title: 新任务：独立写作
steps.reading: My invention is a smart schoolbag. It was invent by my sister. It is made of cloth. It are used to carry books. I like it because it is light and it help me.
steps.teach_html:
新任务：另一个小听众也写了《我的发明》，资料在上面，也有 3 处小毛病。

这次全靠你自己：找出毛病，改对，再自己写三句话。站长不说话了。

steps.title: 哪句做开头
steps.reading: My invention is a smart schoolbag. It was invent by my sister. It is made of cloth. It are used to carry books. I like it because it is light and it help me.
steps.stem: 哪句适合做这篇的开头？
options: I like it because it is light.
My invention is a smart schoolbag. It was invented by my sister.
It is used to carry books.
It is made of cloth.
steps.help: 开头：是什么 + 谁发明。
steps.explain: 开头。

steps.title: 改第一处
steps.scene: 第一处毛病：It was invent by my sister.
steps.reading: My invention is a smart schoolbag. It was invent by my sister. It is made of cloth. It are used to carry books. I like it because it is light and it help me.
steps.stem: “It was invent by my sister.” 怎么改？
options: It was invented by my sister.
It is invented by my sister.
It was inventing by my sister.
Invented by my sister.
steps.explain: invented。

wrong_feedback.B: 过去的事用 was。再想想。

steps.title: 改第二处
steps.scene: 第二处毛病：It are used to carry books.
steps.reading: My invention is a smart schoolbag. It was invent by my sister. It is made of cloth. It are used to carry books. I like it because it is light and it help me.
steps.stem: “It are used to carry books.” 怎么改？
options: It is use to carry books.
They are used to carry books.
It is used to carry books.
It used to carry books.
steps.explain: is used。

wrong_feedback.A: use 是原形，要用 used。再想想。
wrong_feedback.B: 主语是 It，不能换成 They。再想想。

steps.title: 改第三处
steps.stem: “it help me” 应改成？
options: it help me
it helping me
it helped me
it helps me
steps.explain: helps。

wrong_feedback.A: it 后面动词要加 s。再想想。
wrong_feedback.C: 这里是现在，用 helps。再想想。

steps.title: 主动改被动
steps.reading: My invention is a smart schoolbag. It was invent by my sister. It is made of cloth. It are used to carry books. I like it because it is light and it help me.
steps.stem: 主动改被动：“My sister invented it.” 选出正确的被动句。
options: It was invented by my sister.
It is invented by my sister.
It invented by my sister.
It was invent by my sister.
steps.explain: was invented。

wrong_feedback.B: 过去的事用 was。再想想。

steps.title: 哪句做结尾
steps.stem: 哪句适合做这篇的结尾？
options: It is made of cloth.
I like it because it is light and it helps me.
It was invented by my sister.
My invention is a smart schoolbag.
steps.explain: 结尾。

steps.title: 自己写开头
steps.stem: 写出你的发明开头句（从三个里选一个写）：My invention is a robot. / My invention is a lamp. / My invention is a bike.

cn: 我的发明是一个机器人
我的发明是一辆自行车

steps.explain: My invention is ... 是开头的好句子。

common_errors.say: 要写完整的一句：My invention is a robot。再想想。

steps.title: 自己写中间
steps.stem: 写出中间句（从三个里选一个写）：It is used to clean the room. / It is used to carry books. / It is used to tell time.
steps.answer_text: it is used to clean the room

answers: it is used to clean the room
it is used to carry books
it is used to tell time

steps.explain: It is used to ... 是中间的好句子。

common_errors.when: 写了 it is use to
common_errors.say: 要用过去分词 used。再想想。

steps.title: 自己写结尾
steps.stem: 写出结尾句（从三个里选一个写）：I like it because it is useful. / I like it because it helps me. / I like it because it saves time.
steps.answer_text: i like it because it is useful

answers: i like it because it is useful
i like it because it helps me
i like it because it saves time
cn: 我喜欢它因为它省时间

steps.explain: I like it because ... 是结尾的好句子。

common_errors.say: 再加 because 说原因。再想想。

steps.title: 主动改被动
steps.stem: 主动改被动填空：I made it last year. → It ___ made by me last year.
steps.explain: was。

common_errors.say: last year 是过去。再想想。

steps.title: 专栏开张
steps.teach_html:
专栏开张！你的《我的发明》三段式已经很熟了：开头讲是什么、谁发明的，中间讲怎么做、怎么用，结尾讲为什么喜欢。

站长说：下一课是发明大直播，Unit 4 的知识大集合。你来当主播，准备好了吗？

title: 写一写：我的发明
